text: Accepted parallelAutoDiscovery is an async generator. It yields isRedirect, host and scheme, then expects the next call to carry acceptRedirect. Its test first refuses a redirect and expects null, then accepts a fresh redirect and obtains a config. A caller that only awaits a promise would not implement this contract. The view forwards feedback through discoveryStream.next. This note is based on source inspection. Tests were not run, and full review discussion remains pending.
title: Resume a redirecting discovery generator with explicit user feedback
